newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share turnover up, leading shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share turnover up, leading shares higher.

text.p: Turnover on the Latvian stock exchange was buoyant on Thursday, with most of the leading stocks making gains, the bourse said.
Turnover at 74,273 lats was more than double yesterday's and on the official list was led by Riga Transport Fleet. It traded 17,830 lats and gained to one lat from 97 santimes.
Leading stock Unibanka came a close second on trade of 16,606 lats and was unchanged at 2.31 lats.
Third official list stock, Staburadze, which only began trading this week, made its first trades as turnover reached 208 lats and it climbed to 1.39 lats from 1.21.
On the secondary list, business was led by the Daugavpils chain maker on activity of 19,104 lats and it rose slightly to 1.07 lats from 1.05 lats.
Mangali Shipyard was also well-traded at 3,321 lats and it gained one santime to 48 while Riga Yeast turned over 2,772 lats and added 10 santimes to 2.10 lats.
